title: Adding a service writes one internal note naming the service and schedule
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance. Open the schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', or create it with New schedule: add service 'PM-A' with a Calendar trigger of Every 6 months and canned lines, for example 'Engine oil and filter change' 0.8 hours, 'Chassis lubrication, 12 points' 0.5 hours, 'Air filter inspection' 0.3 hours and 'Brake adjustment check' 1.2 hours (4 lines, 2.8 hours). Save.
  3. Open Customers, open customer 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' (create it if missing), open its Assets tab and open unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' (create it with New Asset if missing). Open the asset's Maintenance tab. If the unit is not on the schedule, press Enroll in Schedule, choose 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', enter a last service date for PM-A about seven months ago (for example 6 Mar 2026) and press Enroll. PM-A now reads Overdue on the Maintenance tab.
  4. On the customer page press New Work Order, choose unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' and create the work order (it opens as an estimate). Note its number, for example S3780-15904.
  5. On the work order page, find the Maintenance schedule card inside the asset card at the top and press Expand.
custom_steps:
1. Press Add Service on PM-A, then Add.
  2. Open the work order's Notes tab and read the new note.
  3. Check how the note is marked and whether the customer received any email.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Notes tab gains one short note: PM-A added from ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM. It does not mention copying.
  • The note is internal (in the design: Internal · not visible to the customer) and no email goes to the customer.
  • Adding also writes an audit entry with who did it and when. No screen shows the audit in this version, so the audit entry cannot be checked by hand: write "audit not checked by hand" in the result comment; it does not change pass or fail. Pass or fail on what you can see, and write "audit not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10573 (S17, Add a service to a work order); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S17; Maintenance Reminders V1 main page (Confluence 833290250) as edited 5 October 2026, change log; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S17-R5: “Adding writes one short internal work order note naming the service and the schedule it came from, for example PM-A added from Highway Tractor PM. It never mentions copying; each copied line's own note does, per S16-R23. The note is never visible to the customer, so it sends no customer email”
  • S17-R6: “Adding will write an audit entry with actor and timestamp”
  • Main page change log, 5 Oct 2026: “Audit recorded, no screen in v1.”
